claims.claim_text: The performance of the modular pipeline and the imitation learning approach typically differs by less than 10%.
claims.normalized_text: Modular pipeline and imitation learning performance differ by less than 10%.
claims.source_quote: Surprisingly, the performance of both systems is very close under most testing conditions: the performance of the two methods typically differs by less than 10%.

claims.claim_text: The modular pipeline performs better under the “New weather” condition than under the training conditions.
claims.normalized_text: Modular pipeline performs better on new weather than training weather.
claims.source_quote: One is that the modular pipeline performs better under the “New weather” condition than under the training conditions.

claims.claim_text: The modular pipeline underperforms on navigation in the “New town” condition and on going straight in “New town & weather”.
claims.normalized_text: Modular pipeline underperforms on navigation in new town and new town & weather conditions.
claims.source_quote: Another difference between the two approaches is that MP underperforms on navigation in the “New town” condition and on going straight in “New town & weather”.

claims.claim_text: The perception stack fails systematically under complex weather conditions in the context of a new environment, causing the modular pipeline to fail navigation.
claims.normalized_text: Perception stack failure under complex weather in new environment causes modular pipeline navigation failure.
claims.source_quote: This is because the perception stack fails systematically under complex weather conditions in the context of a new environment.

claims.claim_text: If the perception stack is not able to reliably find a drivable path, the rules-based planner and the classic controller are unable to navigate to the destination in a consistent way.
claims.normalized_text: Failure of perception stack to find drivable path causes planner and controller navigation failure.
claims.source_quote: If the perception stack is not able to reliably find a drivable path, the rules-based planner and the classic controller are unable to navigate to the destination in a consistent way.

claims.claim_text: The performance of the modular pipeline is bimodal: it works well if the perception stack works, otherwise it fails completely.
claims.normalized_text: Modular pipeline performance is bimodal depending on perception stack success.
claims.source_quote: The performance is therefore bimodal: if the perception stack works, the whole system works well; otherwise it fails completely.
